headings.style: tracking-tight, font-bold or font-light for contrast

mono.style: for scores, ranks, and technical data

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use Grid Borders (The 'Technical' Look). Container border-collapse style with subtle borders on right and bottom of grid items. For the games container, use solid backgrounds with 1px border and sharp or max 8px border-radius.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay (opacity 0.03) over the background to kill digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.hover_states: Slight lift (-translate-y-1), border color changes to accent, subtle glow using drop-shadow.

game_card.layout: Bento Grid approach. aspect-square or tall rectangles.
game_card.style: Solid dark surface, 1px border border-zinc-800, hover:border-cyan-500 hover:shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(6,182,212,0.3)].
game_card.content: Minimal icon/graphic (Phosphor Icons), game title in Outfit (text-2xl font-bold), simple 'Joacă acum' (Play now) button.

leaderboard.layout: Compact ranked list. Top 3 treated differently (perhaps slightly larger fonts or subtle accent text color).
leaderboard.style: Rows with border-b border-zinc-800. Monospace font for scores.
leaderboard.interactions: Tabs for Daily / All-time. Highlight the current user's submitted score row.

buttons.style: Sharp or slightly rounded (rounded-md), high contrast. Primary: bg-cyan-500 text-black hover:bg-cyan-400. Secondary: bg-transparent border border-zinc-700 text-white hover:border-zinc-500.

grids_and_layouts.home: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6 p-6 md:p-12. Generous padding to let elements breathe.
grids_and_layouts.game_view: Two-column layout on large screens. Left/Main: Game canvas/area. Right: Local/Global Leaderboard for that game.

motion.transitions: transition-transform duration-200 ease-out, transition-colors duration-200 ease-out
motion.entrance: Staggered fade-up for game cards and leaderboard rows.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure APCA guidelines. Text over interactive elements must be strictly high contrast.

media.icons: @phosphor-icons/react (Duotone or Regular for modern minimal look). Use for game categories, UI elements.

hero_background.description: Abstract geometric network lines, use with low opacity (e.g. 10-15%) or mix-blend-screen as a subtle hero backdrop.

instructions_to_main_agent: Do not implement authentication. Use a simple text input for 'Poreclă' (Nickname) before or after a game to submit score.
Implement games using standard React state or canvas, keeping them completely playable inside the browser.
Leaderboard should be mocked if backend is not available, but UI should support fetching top 10 scores.
Never use 'transition: all', target specific properties like 'transform', 'opacity', 'colors'.
Add 'data-testid' to all interactive elements for testing.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) only for floating elements like sticky navs or modals.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; }.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
GENERAL_UI_UX_DESIGN_GUIDELINES: Keep the interface highly functional. Do not place elements without intention. Emphasize negative space. Provide immediate visual feedback for all interactions. Avoid pure transparent backgrounds on overlays.
